_comment: 1D slab in the DIFFUSIVE regime: Sigma_t 100 over cells of width 0.1, so ten mean free paths per cell, with a scattering ratio of 0.99. This is the regime the removal + AIR composite has nothing to say about and the DSA diffusion correction does - it is the problem the -precon_dsa pins are measured on. Both faces vacuum, so the diffusion operator is nonsingular whatever the ratio.
